title: Explicit proper/open/proper graph presentations and exchanges
statement: For an arbitrary scheme map f:X→Y, an EtaleGraphPresentation is supplied schemes U,P, proper a:X→U, open e:U→P, proper p:P→Y and a;e;p=f. Its ordinary unbounded module-derived functor is Ra_*;De_!;Rp_*. For a compactification c, ofCompactification(c) has a=id_X, e=c.i, p=c.g; openNormalization(c) removes R(id_X)_*. B(c,t) is the literal locallyClosedGraphIso B1;R(B12);B2 inverse, using the graph-model theorem only for Prop properness witnesses. C_c(s,t)=B(c,s) inverse;B(c,t). A BaseChange record supplies the Cartesian representatives of a,e,p; chi is successive exact proper exchange, inverse unit-normalized open base change, then exact proper exchange, with the stated associators. ofCompactificationBaseChange(c,sq) explicitly uses v, pullback.fst c.g b, the identity square and the two compactification pullback squares. These definitions are precisely those formerly attached to the original bundled graph-comparison node; no map is replaced by a chosen endpoint isomorphism.
